Class LhmMetrics

java.lang.Object
oshi.driver.common.windows.LhmMetrics
@ThreadSafe public final class LhmMetrics extends Object
Reads sensor values from the web server of a running LibreHardwareMonitor application.

LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.5 and later no longer publish the ROOT\LibreHardwareMonitor WMI namespace; their built-in web server replaces it. The server is off by default. A user turns it on in the application (Options, Remote Web Server, Run) and gives OSHI its address in GlobalConfig.OSHI_OS_WINDOWS_LHM_URL.

The /metrics endpoint is read rather than /data.json. It is one line per sensor, it gives every value in base units with an invariant decimal point, and its format is the same in every release that has it. The raw value in data.json changed from a localized string with units in 0.9.6 to a number afterward.

  • Method Details

    • query

      public static List<LhmMetrics.Reading> query(String baseUrl)
      Fetches and parses the /metrics endpoint of a LibreHardwareMonitor web server.
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - the server's address, such as http://127.0.0.1:8085; a URL already ending in /metrics is used as given
      Returns:
      the readings, empty if the server could not be reached, is not an http or https address, or returned none

    • parse

      public static List<LhmMetrics.Reading> parse(List<String> lines)
      Parses the /metrics response. Comment lines and samples whose value is not a number are skipped. Where a sensor appears more than once, as in 0.9.5, which lists its recent history, only the sample with the latest timestamp is kept.
      Parameters:
      lines - the response body, one sample per line
      Returns:
      one reading per sensor, in the order each sensor first appears
